title: Damage taken
wikitext:
{{distinguish|Damage taken as}}

'''Damage taken''' refers to the amount of [[damage]] taken after all [[Damage mitigation|mitigations]] have taken place.<ref name="OrderDMGTaken" /> It is a synonym of 'damage dealt', but from a defending standpoint.

==Mechanics==
Modifiers to 'damage taken' (except [[damage taken as]]) apply to the value calculated ''after'' mitigation by resistances and armour.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/gww68s/here_is_one_of_the_new_timeless_jewel_keystones/ft1res0/?context=2</ref><ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/usqtub/why_is_effigy_even_a_thing/i99z2i1/?context=1</ref> See also [[receiving damage]]. 

==Related skill gems==
[[Skill gem]]s that specifies damage taken.

{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables = skill_stats_per_level
|join = skill._pageID=skill_stats_per_level._pageID
|where = skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%damage_taken%"
|level=yes
|int=yes
|dex=yes
|str=yes
|default=Currently, there are no [[active skill gem]]s that specifies damage taken.
}}

==Related unique items==
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%damage_taken_+%"
 |large=1
 |level=1
 |stat=1
}}
